summary: Google DeepMind's Josh Woodward announced that Gemini Spark, a feature that lets Gemini complete multi-step tasks like extracting dates from a PDF and adding them to Google Calendar, is now live for Google AI Pro subscribers in the US, with global expansion planned.

mechanisms.reason: The post describes a shipped feature where Gemini autonomously parses a document and calls the Calendar API to complete a task rather than just responding conversationally.
mechanisms.quote: Drop in a school calendar PDF. Tell Gemini to add every "No School" day to your Google Calendar. Done.

practices.reason: The described feature (document parsing plus calendar tool call) shows a live agentic capability worth evaluating for task automation use cases, though only a single demo is given.
practices.quote: Gemini does more than talk. It gets things done.
